common_family_scope: Ordinary tree with path 0-1-2, m>=1 distinct centers adjacent to 0, center i having r_i in {2,3,4} distinct private tips. N=sum_i r_i, q=N+1, alpha=N+2, L=1+z, G=1+2z, B_r=L^r+z, F_r=sum_{h=0}^{r-2}L^h, Q=product_i B_{r_i}, H_i=product_{h!=i}B_{r_h}, C=GQ, T_i=GF_{r_i}H_i, P=C+zL^q. Coefficients and Delta_k f=f[k+1]-f[k] are integer zero-extended. x=min{k natural: Delta_k P<0}, including terminal difference. An actual eligible lower-half p is natural with x+2<=p, 3p<2alpha+1, 2p<=alpha; j=p-2, delta=q-j, D_j=binom(N,j+1)-binom(N,j)>0. A0=LQ+zL^N, Ai=G B_{r_i-1}H_i+zL^N, e0=1[Delta_p A0<0], ei=1[Delta_p Ai<0], b=e0+sum_i r_i ei, A=sum_i r_i ei T_i[j]. Original endpoint and every private tip retain their separate original tags; empty selection is included.

candidates.statement: For any finite disjoint positive-size blocks V_l of sizes s_l and total M, H=product_l((1+z)^{s_l}+z), any integer 0<=k<=M, and uniform k-subset S of their union, with X_l=1[|S intersect V_l|=1], H[k]/binom(M,k)=E product_l(1+X_l/s_l). Consequently H[k]/binom(M,k)>=product_l(1+1/s_l)^{Pr(X_l=1)}>=exp(y_k), where y_k=sum_l [2s_l/(2s_l+1)] binom(M-s_l,k-1)/binom(M,k); hence for every natural d, H[k]>=binom(M,k) E_d(y_k), E_d(y)=sum_{a=0}^d y^a/a!. The additive and scaled degree-four floors follow. For a path-star cofactor H_i, zero-extend the lower bound outside 0..N-r_i and convolve with GF_{r_i} having coefficients (1,2), (2,5,2), (3,9,7,2) for r_i=2,3,4 respectively to obtain a coefficientwise lower bound on T_i[j].
candidates.scope: General finite disjoint positive blocks for the identity and Jensen inequality, in-range 0<=k<=M for division/powers; zero-extended coefficient floor and nonnegative path-star convolution at every natural j. Empty block family is allowed with H=1. No selector, descent, payment, or aggregate conclusion.
